# BEAR.Security

> Security scanner for BEAR.Sunday applications with OWASP Top 10 compliance

## Overview

BEAR.Security is a PHP security vulnerability scanner designed for BEAR.Sunday framework applications. It provides both static (SAST) and dynamic (DAST) application security testing with 100% OWASP Top 10 coverage.

## Quick Start

```bash
composer require --dev bear/security
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src
```

## Key Features

- 14 SAST detectors (SQL Injection, XSS, Command Injection, Path Traversal, RFI, CSRF, Cryptographic Failures, Insecure Deserialization, Dangerous Functions, Session Security, Open Redirect, XXE, Header Injection, Weak Random)
- AI Auditor with Claude Sonnet integration for deep context-aware analysis
- DAST with Security Headers analysis
- OWASP Top 10 checklist reports
- SARIF output for GitHub Security integration
- Psalm taint analysis enabled

## Documentation

- README: /README.md
- GitHub Actions: /docs/github-actions.md
- VADDY Comparison: /docs/comparison-vaddy.md

## Main Components

- Scanner: src/Scanner.php
- Detectors: src/Detector/
- DAST: src/Dast/
- AI Auditor: src/Ai/
- Reports: src/Report/
- SKILL.md: AI auditor knowledge base (SAST patterns, false positive rules)
- CLI: bin/bear.security-scan (SAST)
- CLI: bin/bear-security-audit (AI Audit, requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
